title: Chamber Solver
description: Solve distinct chambers in the current Rune Delve puzzle campaign. Replaying a room does not count twice.

title: Runic Perfection
description: Collect stars across Rune Delve puzzle chambers. Each room contributes only its best result.

title: Beyond the Seal

title: Secrets of the Hollow
description: Earn mastery stars in connected-room adventures. Each adventure contributes only its best result.
